homeHero.persistence: authoring hints only; persist image/position/opacity through existing advanced.banner fields

fieldGuide.artwork.homeHero: authoring and QA record only; these derived values are not union-profile fields
fieldGuide.artwork.homeHero.bannerPosition: copy the persisted advanced.banner.position value: top-right|bottom-right|top-center
fieldGuide.artwork.homeHero.bannerOpacity: copy the persisted advanced.banner.opacity value; runtime derives a bounded directional scrim strength
fieldGuide.artwork.homeHero.derivedSafeArea: top-right/bottom-right => left; top-center => center; place the focal subject opposite the safe area
fieldGuide.artwork.homeHero.derivedFocusX: top-right/bottom-right => 0.72; top-center => 0.5; image saliency is QA-only and does not override this author signal
fieldGuide.artwork.homeHero.derivedTaskMode: dedicated banner image => banner; global image only => ambient; no art => off-by-absence
fieldGuide.paletteGuidance: derivation hints only; contrast soft|normal|high, temperature cool|neutral|warm. Does NOT replace appearanceMode or the nine explicit semantic colors (contract 1)
fieldGuide.provenance: required before publish; source/license/redistribution are non-empty strings, unofficialFanMade is boolean (contracts 13/28)
